## Description {#details}

<p>Lightweight class that wraps the location operand metadata of a debug intrinsic.</p>


<p>The raw location may be a <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/valueasmetadata">ValueAsMetadata</a>, an empty <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mdtuple">MDTuple</a>, or a <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/diarglist">DIArgList</a>.</p>


<p>Definition at line 243 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/ir/intrinsicinst-h">IntrinsicInst.h</a>.</p>
